title: Chevrolet Chevette Engines by Year (1976–1987)
description: Every factory engine in the Chevrolet Chevette by year, 1976–1987: the 1.4 and 1.6 overhead-cam fours, the 1.6 HO, and the Isuzu-built 1.8 diesel.
intro: The Chevette was Chevrolet's rear-drive subcompact from 1976 to 1987, sold with small overhead-cam fours and, from late 1981, an Isuzu-built 1.8 diesel.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The 1.4 was offered through 1977; from 1978 the Chevette used the 1.6, with a high-output version in 1978–1980.
